distribution: Candidate packs are bundled source assets. When the skill folder is installed from Git, ZIP, or copied into CODEX_HOME/skills, this directory and manifest travel with it. Runtime campaign flows should import these CSVs, not overwrite them.

packs.name: starter-pack
packs.description: Small safe starter pack for first-run smoke tests and users without their own source.
packs.notes: Contains manual-hold examples; selection filters still apply.

packs.name: lxx-ai
packs.description: Chrome-exported LXX directory/profile/classified candidates bundled with the skill.
packs.notes: Raw page showed 3328 backlinks; bundled CSV is URL-normalized, deduped, filtered to DR>=20 when DR is known, with obvious spam domains removed. Manual-hold platforms are marked and deprioritized.

packs.name: ahrefs-competitor-backlinks
packs.description: Competitor backlink reverse-engineering candidates; inspect route before submitting.
packs.notes: Filtered to DR>=20 when DR is known; domain_seen_count boosts repeated platforms.

packs.name: legacy-226-review
packs.description: Legacy 226-pool blog-comment URLs with a prior URL field signal; must re-audit in browser.
packs.notes: Review-only pack; DR is usually unknown and previous audit labels are not final.
